text: 62 year old male, crushing chest pain. Gave aspirin 300 mg chewed at 10:42. Nitroglycerin 0.4 mg sublingual at 10:45. 18 gauge IV in the left AC. 12 lead ECG done. BP 140/90, heart rate 96.
Unresponsive female about 25, resp rate 6. Bagged with BVM. Naloxone 2 mg intranasal at 22:10, repeated 2 mg intranasal after 3 minutes. GCS now 14.
Anaphylaxis after peanuts. Epi point three milligrams IM to the right thigh. Diphenhydramine 50 mg IV. Started a 20 gauge in the right hand, normal saline 1 litre bolus.
Cardiac arrest, CPR in progress on arrival. Shocked once at 200 joules. Epinephrine 1 mg IO at 03:12. Amiodarone 300 mg IO. i-gel placed. ROSC at 03:25.
Diabetic, blood glucose 42. D50 25 grams IV push via 22 gauge left forearm at 07:30. Recheck sugar 110.
Asthmatic, wheezing. Salbutamol 5 mg nebulised with ipratropium 0.5 mg. Oxygen 6 litres per minute via mask. Patient on home inhaler, not used today.
Fall from ladder, open tib fib fracture right leg. Splinted, pressure dressing applied. Fentanyl 50 micrograms IV at 16:05, another 50 micrograms at 16:15. Ondansetron 4 mg IV.
Seizing for 6 minutes. Midazolam 10 mg IM at 11:20, seizure stopped at 11:24. Suctioned airway. Patient refused transport initially. We did not give diazepam.
SVT rate 210. Vagal maneuver failed. Adenosine 6 mg rapid IV push at 13:02, then 12 mg at 13:05, converted to sinus. Cardiac monitor attached.
Motorbike crash, suspected spinal injury. C-collar on, spine board. Tranexamic acid 1 gram IV over 10 minutes. Tourniquet on left thigh at 19:40.

Female patient, umar 30 saal, bee sting ke baad saans phool rahi thi. 5 minute pehle adrenaline 0.5 mg IM right thigh mein diya. Left hand mein 20 gauge cannula lagaya aur NS 500 ml start kiya. Avil 22.75 mg IV diya.
Bachcha 10 saal ka, asthma attack. Asthalin 2.5 mg nebulization diya 15:05 pe. Oxygen 6 litre mask se start kiya. SpO2 89 se 95 ho gaya.
Uncle ji ko seene mein dard, 55 saal. Disprin 300 mg chaba ke khilaya 9:10 pe. Sorbitrate 5 mg jeebh ke neeche rakha. ECG kiya, BP 160/100.
Accident case, sir pe chot, khoon beh raha tha. Pressure patti baandhi. Cannula 18G right hand mein, RL 1 litre chala diya. Ondem 4 mg IV diya ulti ke liye.
Patient behosh tha, sugar 40 aayi glucometer pe. 25 gram dextrose nas mein diya 10 minute pehle. Ab hosh mein hai, GCS 15.
Mirgi ka daura, 8 minute se chal raha tha. Midazolam 5 mg naak se diya 14:30 baje. Daura ruk gaya. Suction kiya.
Haath ki haddi tooti lag rahi hai, splint lagaya. Dard ke liye paracetamol 1 gram IV diya. Patient ne tramadol ke liye mana kar diya.
Dil ki dhadkan band, CPR shuru kiya 02:10 pe. AED se ek jhatka diya. Adrenaline 1 mg IV har 3 minute, do baar diya.
मरीज़ 70 साल के पुरुष, बेहोश मिले। शुगर 38 आई। दाहिने हाथ में कैनुला लगाया और 25 ग्राम डेक्सट्रोज़ नस में दिया 09:15 पर।
महिला को सीने में दर्द है। 300 मिलीग्राम एस्पिरिन चबाने को दी 11:30 बजे। ऑक्सीजन 4 लीटर प्रति मिनट शुरू की।
मधुमक्खी के काटने के बाद सांस में तकलीफ। एड्रेनालिन 0.5 मिलीग्राम जांघ की मांसपेशी में दिया। नॉर्मल सलाइन 500 एमएल नस से चालू किया।
सड़क दुर्घटना, पैर की हड्डी टूटी। पट्टी बाँधी और स्प्लिंट लगाया। दर्द के लिए 50 माइक्रोग्राम फेंटानिल नस में दिया।
65 saal ki mahila, ghutno ka dard bahut zyada hai, chal nahi pa rahi. Paracetamol 650 mg muh se diya 08:40 pe.
Ladka 19 saal, bike se gira, kandhe mein dard aur sujan. Sling aur splint lagaya. Ibuprofen 400 mg oral diya.
Sir mein tez dard aur ulti, BP 180/110. Ondem 4 mg IV diya, cannula 20G left hand mein.
पेट में तेज़ दर्द, उल्टी हो रही है। ओंडांसेट्रॉन 4 मिलीग्राम नस में दिया।
